svg.title: C4 style container and technology boundaries for IDEA Core v0
svg.desc: An engineer uses either a browser or the IDEA Desktop. The Desktop contains a narrow WPF and WebView2 host for the React interface. A separate Workspace process manages local engineering files and tools. All protected product calls go to one IDEA Server. The Server owns product coordination and uses PostgreSQL, a private Artifact Store and a separate Format Worker through labelled contracts.
